sentences.text:
As case against Accused No.1 was split up, the Police-Inspector of Basavanagudi Women P.S. has filed split up chargesheet against Accused No.1 in C.C.No.10868/2007 for the offences punishable U/s.498A of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
 2. The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt. Shabana Begum.
The gist of the prosecution case is that the accused No.1 married CW-1 on 09-06- 2002.
At the time of marriage, the accused No.1 along with other accused have demanded and taken gold ornaments, home appliances and cash of Rs.10,000/- as dowry from the parents of CW-1.
After the marriage, the accused No.1 along with other accused have subjected CW-1 to mental and physical cruelty demanding her to bring Rs.One lakh as additional dowry.
Based on  3  C.C.No.10868/2007 the said information, a case in Cr.No.338/2003 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.
3. After filing of splitup chargesheet, accused remained continuously absent, and there are no chances of securing the accused No.1 even after issuance of NBW and proclamation U/s.82 & 83 Cr.P.C.
, on 21-8-2023 this case records was sent for seeking permission to transfer the case LPR .
The Hon'ble Dist & Sessions Court pleased to permit to register the case records in L.PR.
On 27- 11-2024 accused No.1 present who is already a proclaimed offender and he was remanded to JC .

Later accused No.1 was enlarged on Shabana Begum vs Syued Akbar on 5 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89323026/
2 bail.
 4. Before framing charge an opportunity of being heard was provided to the accused and after hearing him and the prosecution and as there was sufficient materials, the charge for the aforesaid offences was framed and same was read over to the accused in the language known to him, to which, the accused pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
The plea of the accused was recorded.
Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution evidence.
5. The learned Sr.APP filed Memo adopting the evidence already recorded in C.C.No.3927/2004.
The Counsel for accused  4  C.C.No.10868/2007 also states that she also adopts the cross examination in the splitup case.
Accordingly, same evidence is adopted in the instant splitup case.
In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and P.2 documents.

As there was no any incriminating evidence appearing against the accused, the recording of Statement of Accused as required U/s.
313 of Cr.P.C., was dispensed with.
6. Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused person caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  and threatened her and thereby accused have  committed the offences punishable U/s.498A of IPC. &
Sec.3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.?
 2) what order?
Shabana Begum vs Syued Akbar on 5 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89323026/
3  8.

My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........ As per final order, for the following:
 REASONS  9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond  5  C.C.No.10868/2007 reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement.
Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.

10. PW-1 Mosid Khan in his examination-in-chief has deposed that he do not know either CW-1 or her parents and deposed that he do not know the accused and he do not know about the ill treatment given to CW-1.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined him.
During the course of cross examination, he denied the suggestions put to him and nothing worth could be elicited from his mouth.

11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that CW-1 being the informant, key and material witness did not stepped into the witness box and depose about the incident,
which is fatal to the prosecution case.
PW-1 being mahazar witness has turned hostile to the prosecution case.
In the absence of the material witnesses being examined by the prosecution this court Shabana Begum vs Syued Akbar on 5 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89323026/
4 holds that the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the  6  C.C.No.10868/2007 accused no.1 beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
12. POINT No.2:-

For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER
In exercise of power conferred Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., Accused No.1 is acquitted of the offences punishable U/s. 498A of IPC. & Sec. 3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The bail bonds of accused No.1 shall be in force for a period of 6 months.

(Dictated to the Stenographer directly on the computer and print out taken by her is verified,
corrected & then pronounced by me in the Open Court dated this the 05-04-2025).
(SYED ARFATH IBRAHIM M.) XXXVII ACJM., BENGALURU.
